title: Teamcenter Developer
description:
**Company Description**
Thinkinnov Solution Technologies Private Limited delivers innovative Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions built on a strong foundation of best practices, domain expertise, and technical knowledge. Drawing on over a decade of experience across multiple industries, the company designs scalable PLM implementations that help organizations achieve their long-term strategic objectives. The team specializes in setting up PLM processes for mass production, make-to-order, and engineer-to-order environments, covering the full project lifecycle from strategic consulting to sustaining services. With a focus on on-time, high-quality delivery, Thinkinnov Solution’s motivated and expert professionals tackle complex challenges and provide practical, results-oriented solutions for customers.
  
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a Teamcenter Developer. The Teamcenter Developer will configure, customize, and maintain Siemens Teamcenter PLM environments, including user roles, workflows, and data models to support engineering and manufacturing processes. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and optimize PLM usage for mass production, job shop, make-to-order, and engineer-to-order operations. The individual will create and maintain documentation, provide user training and support, and ensure adherence to PLM best practices and company standards. Daily responsibilities also include participating in implementation and upgrade projects, testing new functionalities, and coordinating with stakeholders to improve system performance and data integrity.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong PLM skills, including experience with Siemens Teamcenter configuration, customization, workflow management, and data modeling.
* Candidates should possess business process skills related to engineering change management, product data management, BOM management, and lifecycle processes in manufacturing or engineering organizations.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills, including requirements gathering, issue diagnostics, root-cause analysis, and performance optimization within PLM environments.
* Candidates should possess collaboration and communication skills to work with engineers, project managers, and IT teams, including clear documentation practices and user training capabilities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in PLM implementation or support.
* Familiarity with discrete manufacturing, job shop, make-to-order, or ETO environments and prior exposure to end-to-end PLM project phases is beneficial.

title: Network Automation Solution Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Automation Solution Developer, you will validate Service Portals and ensure their reliability for leading telecom operators. Working with agile, cross\-functional teams, you will develop and execute test strategies for orchestration, automation, and service assurance across IP/MPLS networks. You will leverage test automation tools, troubleshoot issues, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to continuous integration and delivery, helping deliver high\-quality network automation solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and implement comprehensive end\-to\-end test strategies for Service Portals, focusing on performance and reliability.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework for regression, functional, and system testing.
* Validate complex IP/MPLS network topologies, ensuring thorough testing of orchestration and automation functionalities.
* Troubleshoot issues, conduct root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing within the release process.
* Review and assess product requirements and design documents to ensure they meet testability standards.
* Mentor junior QA engineers, providing guidance and participating in peer reviews to enhance team skills.
* Report on quality metrics, defect tracking, and performance validation to ensure high\-quality product releases.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Telecommunications, IP Networking, or related field
* 10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with at least 2 years in the telecom/networking domain.
* Proficiency in Robot Framework, Python/Java scripting, and test automation design patterns
* Strong understanding of IP and network virtualization concepts.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Familiarity with Nokia NSP architecture and service provisioning (e.g., L3VPN, TE tunnels)
* Experience with Linux\-based environments, network emulators (e.g., IXIA, Spirent), and protocol analyzers (e.g., Wireshark)
* Excellent analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits in India:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work–life balance
